strategy.summary: Commit 62d8c6f added a per-line findProduct() call inside a loop in GET /orders/:id (src/app.js), an N+1 that makes 8 extra sequential store round trips (~6–9 ms each) per order, raising the `detail` scenario's p95 from 22 ms to 88 ms and p99 from 24 ms to 90 ms. Guard it with scenario-keyed thresholds added to perf/orders.js (existing thresholds and scenarios kept unchanged) at the baseline plus 20% headroom, and record/file the defect.
inScope: Thresholds on http_req_duration{scenario:detail} p(95) and p(99) in perf/orders.js, added beside the existing thresholds
Work item tag comment at the top of perf/orders.js
Defect record and GitHub issue for the detail slowdown
outOfScope: Changing application code to fix the N+1 (a person's work)
perf/search.js and the list scenario: no confirmed slowdown
assumptions: Thresholds are set from the baseline medians given in the work item (p95 22 ms, p99 24 ms) with 20% headroom: p(95)<26.4, p(99)<28.8.
The app runs for real at BASE_URL (default http://localhost:4310); nothing is faked.
Existing thresholds (http_req_failed rate<0.01, http_req_duration p(95)<2000), scenarios and checks stay unchanged.

defects.title: Order detail (GET /orders/:id) p95/p99 latency up ~4x: N+1 product lookups
defects.description: perf/orders.js › detail: p95 latency 22 ms → 88 ms (+299%, 89 ms on rerun), p99 24 ms → 90 ms (+270.3%, 93 ms on rerun), against the median of the last 5 good runs. Bisect: first slow at 62d8c6ffbfbb "Show each line's product name on an order" (PR #111). Its change to src/app.js adds `for (const line of items) line.productName = (await findProduct(line.productId)).name;` in the /orders/:id route: one sequential findProduct store query per line. Every store query is a round trip of ~6–9 ms (src/store.js ROUND_TRIP_MS + JITTER_MS), and each order has 8 lines, so a request goes from 2 round trips to 10. Expected (AC1/AC2): detail p(95)<26.4 ms and p(99)<28.8 ms; actual ~88/90 ms. Fix belongs in the app, e.g. return the product name from orderLines in the same query it already joins prices in.
defects.evidence: TestForge measurement: detail p95 88 ms (rerun 89), p99 90 ms (rerun 93) vs baseline 22/24 ms; bisect first failed at 62d8c6ffbfbb. Threshold 'http_req_duration{scenario:detail}': ['p(95)<26.4','p(99)<28.8'] in perf/orders.js.
